instruction: I find Vim's default search highlighting confusing. Please search online to find out how to enable incremental search highlighting in Vim and configure it permanently in my local Vim settings.

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'alt', 't'); time.sleep(0.5)

parameters.command:
cat > eval_incsearch__4dc24072.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
if grep -q "set incsearch" ~/.vimrc 2>/dev/null || grep -q "set is" ~/.vimrc 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "Incremental Search Enabled!"
else
    echo "Incremental search not configured"
fi
EOF
chmod +x eval_incsearch__4dc24072.sh
